title: Aishwaraabimasthu
desc: Vasu and Saravanan are best friends since childhood. However, their friendship is put to a test when they fall in love with Seema and Aishwarya, respectively.

title: Raja Rani
desc: Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.

title: Maari 2
desc: Maariyappan, a gangster, is confronted by Gangadhar Beeja, a rival. While he strives to defeat him, he attempts to cope with his son's questionable behaviour.

title: Mad 2
desc: Laddu narrates his Goa adventure to jail visitors, where a stolen necklace, gangster Maxx and undercover cop Ashok lead to chaos, arrests and Laddu's jail time.

title: Skanda: The Attacker
desc: After Rayudu and Ranjith Reddy's children elope, the CMs turn against each other. However, when a college student kidnaps Reddy's daughter, a revenge saga unravels.

title: Kabali
desc: A man spends 25 years in prison for fighting against oppression. Old but still bloodthirsty, he decides to seek revenge against his enemies upon his release.

title: Action
desc: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit.

title: Fun Time
desc: The programme includes comedy clips from Tollywood movies.

title: Saptagiri LLB
desc: Sapthagiri, a lawyer, decides to reopen and pursue an old case to gather money and fame. However, he has to later face multiple obstacles while gathering evidence.

title: Manamantha
desc: Four individuals from different walks of life chase ambitions, face dilemmas and make sacrifices, unknowingly influencing one another in ways they never imagined.

title: Julayi
desc: When Ravi unknowingly thwarts Bittu's bank heist, he becomes the target of Bittu's wrath. Subsequently, Ravi is forced to fight to protect his loved ones from the ruthless criminal.

title: Chandramukhi
desc: When a royal family starts to witness paranormal incidents in their mansion, they get in touch with a renowned psychiatrist to trace and tackle the possessed individual.

title: Mr. X
desc: A renegade operative competes with the clock to prevent a nuclear disaster.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
desc: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity.
